visualCharacteristics: Flat responsive grid of article/adventure cards (typically 4-up). Each card is a photo on top with a linked title and a short description below; no border or card background.
contentPattern: One row per card, cells: image cell + body cell (linked title + short description).
usage: Homepage 'Recent Articles' and 'Where do you want to go?' grids (same variant, used twice). Also reused for the magazine (/us/en/magazine) article grid.
